title: Member Benefits Schedule: Wayfare Pass Goodwill on Cleaning and Damage Fees Level-Difference Refunds
content:
**Rule.** The Pass goodwill of a Cleaning and Damage Fees level-difference refund is read from the rider's Wayfare Pass membership in active status: Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly, Wayfare Pass Plus Annual and Wayfare Pass All Access Annual take the Plus-tier refund goodwill; Wayfare Pass Monthly, Wayfare Pass Annual and Wayfare Pass Student take the base-tier refund goodwill; a rider with no active membership takes no Pass goodwill.

| Plan of the rider's Wayfare Pass (rider membership), in active status | Pass goodwill on a level-difference refund |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | $10.00 (Plus-tier refund goodwill) |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | $10.00 (Plus-tier refund goodwill) |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | $10.00 (Plus-tier refund goodwill) |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | $5.00 (base-tier refund goodwill) |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | $5.00 (base-tier refund goodwill) |
| Wayfare Pass Student | $5.00 (base-tier refund goodwill) |
| no membership in active status | none |

The plan and status come from the rider's membership record in Wayfare Pass (rider membership). The Pass goodwill is a fixed amount added to the level-difference refund; the total refund is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A level-difference refund of $40.00 for a rider on an active Wayfare Pass Monthly membership becomes $45.00 with the Pass goodwill.
